result.description: Used to evaluate success or failure in Flow and can be any value you wish to return for evaluation

reference.description: A unique hash generated by Flow based on SessionID and SourceID that allows us to identify the user's session. This value is automatically appended as a query parameter on external links and should be intercepted and returned with the callback for validation (in header and body): e.g. `https://www.example.com?reference=f7_4hn5=8f&%#nK=`

data.description: An optional hashmap with any key and value that can be referenced in the flow later on.
